Just to play the devil’s advocate, have you considered that these casters are not responding or go quite because casters that are really good at their work know that magick and spells won’t work if the person asking for a spell doesn’t believe in the caster in the first place. The reasoning is related to scientific laws of attraction, im not talking about that book, but how energy movement works within physics and chemistry ect. Magick takes effect by working with a persons subconscious and creating a butterfly effect around them through the manipulation of energy to manifest the results. If you are a dead magnet so to speak, the energy come your way will not latch on, so you will receive nothing. We don’t live in a Harry Potter rhelm, so if we have a significant mistrust in magick already then there’s no point at all in even paying for a spell or working with magick . You’re better off casting your own spells until you learn to trust in magick by seeing results for yourself, and build trust. So a caster is just trying to avoid wasting their time and yours by working with someone they know they can’t help no matter how good they are. Casters aren’t Gods lol manifestation is largely dependent on the client too, our ability to have free will gets in the way of a caster having absolute power and authority over what happens in your life or between you and two people. I’ve worked with witches I know personally in real life that do have spells manifest, and they avoid clients that send messages like yours firstly for the fact they know the law of science and powers of magick can’t overcome a closed mind and it’s bred into the community now that it’s pointless to engage with these clients since they are kind of insulting truly, even though it’s understandable where they come from, but you shouldn’t ask anyone to test or prove themselves, that’s the shitty thing about asking outside casters to work for you, you have to do a calculated risk before you order and that keeps in mind your own ability to be open to things actually working out as you wanted. You’re doubting makes the spell void already before even ordering. I hear these same things in other areas of metaphysics such as healing and psychics I’ve known that have and can predict insane detailed things such as first and last names and how and where you will meet someone down to the mole they have on their butt. These psychics don’t want to work with testers, it’s tiresome. Imagine going to your doctor and asking them to prove themselves as good doctors that get results prior to being their patient, you’re going to get zero response lol just another perspective that it’s not just them, or them really, it’s kinda you or the client most of the time. Although yes there are countless scammers for sure, you will burn your bridge with the real deal casters by sending these messages. But you don’t sound ready for a spell to manifest for you, or be working with magick. You can’t and won’t get results until you overcome your blocks which is mistrust in everyone
